William James, A Pluralistic Universe.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-james/a-pluralistic-universe

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William James, the author, the annotator, died 1910.

First publication of the text used: A Pluralistic Universe was published in 1909 by William James.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1909, before 1931. Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (quoted below). A work published in 1909 enters the United States public domain on 1 January 2005.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (the last died in 1910), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
